responsibility: Declares the table of target builtins exposed by the GCN backend, including flat-memory load/store operations, math/vector operations, compare-and-swap primitives, and OpenMP/OpenACC and kernel-input helpers. Each entry binds a builtin identifier to its user-visible name, argument and result type signature, optional instruction code, and expansion routine, supplying the data from which the backend builds builtin enums and initialization tables.
